description: CSV, JSON and YAML. Convert a table from one format to another. Commas and line breaks inside fields do not break the parser. Runs in the browser — the data stays with you. Accepts text/csv, text/tab-separated-values, application/json, application/yaml, text/yaml, .csv, .tsv, .json, .yaml, .yml; up to 20 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: data_convert
